make_or_buy_basis: Optimizer-selected 250 kW motor class; CAD baseline carries the promoted envelope.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: supplier coating, lubrication preservation, earthing/bonding, and thermal labels
material_spec.form_factor: preassembled motor, gearbox, coupling, seals, oil ports, and mounting hardware
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail traction specification plus project EMC, thermal, and mount-load evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: traction motor / gearbox / coupling certified equipment class
material_spec.nominal_section: bogie motor-cradle and axle interface frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: serialised drive equipment CoC, test report, oil data, and revision record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: The current HM47-class planning envelope is not an ABB order code; ABB must confirm a 250 kW continuous / 350 kW short-peak, 800 V-compatible configuration and mass envelope.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Buy the initial motor; local rewind, bearings and eventually a locally manufactured equivalent require the frozen torque-speed, cooling, insulation, shaft, foot, mass and EMC interfaces plus type tests.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
